status: SPECIFIED ONLY - not run; each session is a model call that needs separate owner approval
when: only AFTER the six are frozen (qualification_v9.freeze_before_checklists); one task at a time
allowed_inputs: issue text (the task problem_statement as given to arm A, redacted)
the pinned base repository (one commit, no remotes)
QB contract schema and registry docs
forbidden_inputs: prior trial results or other arms' output

session_settings.model_requested: claude-opus-5-5 (served model read back from the stream and recorded)
session_settings.launch: owner-launched in a clean packet folder containing only the allowed inputs; --permission-mode default; MCP servers stripped; web tools disallowed
session_settings.bounds: at most 3 sessions per task (1 authoring + at most 2 repair/format sessions), each at most 45 min wall clock; stop on any subscription limit, no paid fallback

record_notes.tokens: input / output / cache read / cache write from the session's own usage records
record_notes.transcript: kept as a restricted artifact; only its sha256 and the audit result (allowed inputs only, no forbidden access) are public
record_notes.ai_review_rounds: count of AI senior review rounds before freeze; AI review is NOT human sign-off
record_notes.owner_minutes: owner's self-reported minutes for launching, relaying and approving

freeze: the contract is frozen (sha256 recorded) before any gold or reference replay; never edited after
reference_replay: preferred AFTER the trial captures; if run earlier: controller-only counts, no feedback to authors or coding sessions, no contract tuning or task replacement from the result
failures: a session that cannot produce a valid contract, or a contract that fails its validators, is recorded as a QB preparation failure for that frozen task (unresolved outcome); the task is not replaced
reporting: authoring cost is reported as arm B preparation, separately and in total-work comparisons
